## Work History

Role: Independent Designer
Dates: October 2025 – Present
- Designed and shipped a direct-to-consumer merch storefront on Shopify Hydrogen, end-to-end from design to production deployment
- Built a platform-agnostic design system (CSS custom properties + Swift) governing color, surface hierarchy, shape, and motion across web and iOS; synced via Tokens Studio with no manual re-entry

- Authored INSTRUCTIONS.md as a reproducible onboarding workflow for developers and AI coding tools
